info.title: mccontrol
info.description: The backend of mccontrol on 127.0.0.1: configuration, keys, the device directory, command sets, history, the command table and help, and the long-running verbs as jobs. JSON in and out, UTF-8. A job is started by POST /jobs/<verb> (202 with the job), followed by GET /jobs/<id> until its status is no longer running, and cancelled by DELETE /jobs/<id>. Every error is {"error": {"code", "message"}}; inside a job it is the job's error, with the same codes (broker and beacon for the network). Every route lives under the base URL serve() returns, http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<secret>/, which is why the server entry is relative: a request outside it is a 404 with an empty body. Any route also answers 403 (forbidden) to a request whose Origin header is not the server's own, 415 (unsupported_media_type) to a body that is not application/json, 405 (method_not_allowed) to a method the path does not take, and 500 (internal) to a fault.

get.description: Parsed from what the device answered: the last answer to each read and every command's reply in its history, newest winning. `get <key>` answered `> value` is the fact `key`; `set <key> <value>` answered OK is the same fact; `ver` is `version`, `region` is `regions`, `get autoreply` gives `autoreply`, `autoreply.hops`, `autoreply.mode`, `autoreply.direct.flood`, `autoreply.private` and `autoreply.channel`. A read the table does not know is listed under `raw`.

cautions.description: With confirm_required only: each command that takes something away and what it takes

password_set.description: whether a broker password is set; the password itself is never returned

tested.description: the last connection test (POST /jobs/test): to which broker and port, whether every step passed, when

ui.description: the interface `mccontrol --ui` starts when none is named: the last one named; empty for none (Monolith then)

ui_settings.description: each interface's own preferences, by interface name then key, for it alone to read; {} when none is kept

Config.description: The control broker and how long to wait; command sets and shortcuts have their own routes.

password.description: set here, never returned: GET /config says password_set

ui_settings.description: merged into what is kept, interface by interface and key by key: an interface not named and a key not named stay as they are, a key given a value takes it, a key given null is deleted, and an interface left with no keys goes. Each interface's value must be an object, or the whole change is a 400

ConfigChange.description: Only the fields given change; an unknown field is a 400.

provision.description: the two serial lines that provision a repeater

overwrite.description: replace an existing key: every node provisioned with it stops listening

seed.description: import this 64-hex seed instead of generating one

node.description: the first 8 hex characters of the node's public key

key.description: the whole 64-hex key, known from ar-11 on

stale.description: sent to, and nothing heard for seven days

row.description: the directory row laid out to the asked width

Adopt.description: A discovered node to remember; a taken name gets -2, -3 ...

forgot.description: the first 8 hex characters of the node's public key

verified.description: true: signed by the node; false: BAD SIGNATURE; null: unsigned, no answer, or a line from before this was kept
true: the node signed the answer; null: unsigned (an r1 from older firmware, Beacon's line, or kept before signatures were). A bad signature is never kept

key.description: the setting, as the firmware names it (txdelay, autoreply.hops), or version, regions

label.description: the key as a person reads it

at.description: when it was learned, local time

age.description: how long ago, short: now, 5 min, 2 h, 3 d

source.description: the command whose answer carried it

read.description: the command that reads it again

verified.description: true: the node signed the answer; null: unsigned (an r1 from older firmware, or kept before signatures were); a bad signature teaches nothing

facts.description: known settings first, in a fixed order, then the rest by key

raw.description: reads the fact table does not know, newest first

read.description: the reply is kept in the reads

probe.description: the sample the admission is judged on

admitted.description: does the device's firmware admit it; null with no device

needs.description: the oldest build that admits it

refusal.description: why the deny list refuses the probe; null when it travels

hidden.description: the device's image is built without the feature this command belongs to (lou-14: a trigger or an autoreply setting without auto-reply); not offered at all, unlike a greyed entry

revision.description: the revision the version reports, lou-N from lou-14 and ar-N before it; null when it reports none

features.description: the features the device's version names: ar, rc, arrc, ...; arrc for every version before lou-14; null without a device

lacks.description: ar or rc when the device's image is built without the feature the command needs; null otherwise or without a device

example.caution: stops this repeater forwarding every message that carries no scope. It may be the only link between two places that rely on that.

TagChange.description: devices by name, node or unique prefix, and/or every device of a region

heard.description: the nodes heard so far in the current wait, as the transport reports them

cancellable.description: whether a cancel can interrupt this verb's waits: false for test and register, whose broker waits take no callback; discover stops listening and the regions left, but not the name read after a region

result.description: the verb's result; its schema is the operation's x-result-schema

confirm.description: required true for a command that takes something away (see /commands/check)

SendJob.description: Exactly one target: devices, tagged (the tagged devices), or region (one broadcast).

region.description: JKG, several with commas, or * for every region you have

add.description: remember every node not yet in the directory

TargetsJob.description: devices, or the tagged; neither means every device

stats.description: Beacon's status block: battery_mv, uptime_secs, noise_floor, tx_air_secs, rx_air_secs, packets_sent, packets_received, errors, recv_errors, queue_len, internal_heap

sample.description: the latest Beacon status, null when Beacon has none

points.description: the telemetry buckets, oldest first; null when Beacon has none

command.description: a table entry text, as GET /commands lists it

values.description: the chosen choice, choices or typed value; empty ones are dropped

BadRequest.description: A malformed body or parameter, a command the node would refuse (refused), or a store refusal (store)

NotFound.description: No such route, device, set, topic or job

Conflict.description: The state forbids it: a key or a name exists (conflict), a command that takes something away was not confirmed (confirm_required), or the job has already finished (finished)
